art.title: Saint Martin and the Beggar
art.why: 'A portrait of virtue': the soldier on a white horse beside a nearly nude man, the classic picture of charity as an act of character. Workshop version (1600/1614); the El Greco autograph is not used here.

music.why: Sings of a God who is holy in himself: the theist's reply to the Euthyphro, that goodness is God's nature, not his whim.
O virtus Sapientiae: Wisdom ordering all things, the medieval picture behind natural law.
An old Irish prayer that puts love of God first and lets everything else follow: the verdict's order.
